q: How do I get started with CognitiveBotics?
a: Your therapist invites you to CognitiveBotics and sets up your child's programme, so home activities are connected to your child's therapy plan from the very beginning.

q: Who creates my child’s learning plan?
a: Your child's learning plan is created by their therapist based on their individual strengths, developmental needs and intervention goals.

q: Do I need training to run sessions at home?
a: No. CognitiveBotics provides short, guided videos that show parents exactly how to support each activity, making home sessions easy to fit into everyday routines.

q: How will I know if early intervention is working?
a: CognitiveBotics tracks your child's progress over time with clear, easy-to-understand reports, helping parents and therapists monitor developmental goals together.

q: Is giving my child screen time beneficial?
a: Educational screen time can support learning when it is purposeful, interactive and developmentally appropriate. Research suggests the quality of screen time has a greater impact than the amount of time alone.
source: "Vulnerabilities Prompting Use of Technology and Screen by Mothers of Autistic Children in India: Lived Experiences and Comparison to Scientific Literature"
Published in Culture, Medicine, and Psychiatry (Springer Nature)
